script.title: NEW AT THE PARTY
script.scene_zh: 聚會客廳 · 初識聊天
script.story_hook: Two strangers, one snack table, zero friends.
script.intro_zh: 兩個陌生人，一張點心桌，一個朋友也沒有。
script.welcome_en: Today two guests become friends at a party. Listen for name tricks!
script.welcome_zh: 今天兩位賓客在聚會中成為朋友。注意聽名字的技巧！
script.outro: See? A snack table can start a friendship. Great listening!
script.outro_zh: 看吧，一張點心桌就能開始一段友誼。聽得很棒！
script.practice_intro_en: Now repeat the introduction phrases with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟我重唸自我介紹常用句。
script.char_a_description: a slim East Asian woman in her late twenties with straight black hair in a low ponytail, wearing a mustard-yellow knit sweater, wide cream trousers, small gold hoop earrings, and clean white sneakers
script.char_b_description: a broad-shouldered Latino man in his mid thirties with curly dark hair and a short beard, wearing a rust-colored corduroy jacket, dark indigo jeans, brown boots, and a woven bracelet

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, go ahead. I'm terrible at napkin races.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɔri ɡoʊ əˈhɛd aɪm ˈtɛrəbəl æt ˈnæpkɪn ˈreɪsəz/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉你先拿，我搶餐巾紙從來沒贏過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Please, take them. I only came for the dip.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæ pliz teɪk ðɛm aɪ ˈoʊnli keɪm fɚ ðə dɪp/
dialogue.zh: 哈！請拿請拿，我來這裡只為了蘸醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart plan. Nothing else here makes sense to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt plæn ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls hɪr meɪks sɛns tə mi/
dialogue.zh: 好策略。這裡的一切對我都很陌生。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New face too? I only know Julia from cycling.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu feɪs tu aɪ ˈoʊnli noʊ ˈdʒuljə fɚm ˈsaɪklɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 妳也是新面孔？我只在騎車社團認識茱莉亞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same! Well, I barely know Julia at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm wɛl aɪ ˈbɛrli noʊ ˈdʒuljə ət ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 跟我一樣！其實我幾乎根本不認識茱莉亞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So how do you know her?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ haʊ du ju noʊ hɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那妳怎麼會認識她？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her roommate posted my lost-cat flyer.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɚ ˈrumˌmeɪt ˈpoʊstɪd maɪ lɔst kæˈtwaɪɚ/
dialogue.zh: 她室友貼過我找貓的啟事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No way! You're the cat person from the group chat?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ weɪ jʊrz ðə kæˈt ˈpɜrsən fɚm ðə ɡrup tʃæt/
dialogue.zh: 不會吧！妳就是群組裡那個貓的主人？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guilty. It's a long, very sad story.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɪlti ɪts ə lɔŋ ˈvɛri sæd ˈstɔri/
dialogue.zh: 就是我。說來話長，而且很悲傷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm Theo, by the way. Big nerd, small bike.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈθi.oʊ baɪ ðə weɪ bɪɡ nɜrd smɔl baɪk/
dialogue.zh: 對了我是西奧。書呆子一枚，腳踏車也小小一臺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Iris. Hi, Theo. Nerd noted. Cat person, mostly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaɪrɪs haɪ ˈθi.oʊ nɜrd ˈnoʊtɪd ˈkæt ˈpɜrsən ˈmoʊstli/
dialogue.zh: 艾莉絲。嗨西奧，書呆子收到。我主要是貓奴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Iris. Nice name. Like the flower, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaɪrɪs naɪs neɪm laɪk ðə ˈflaʊɚ raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 艾莉絲，好美的名字，像花一樣，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's what everyone says. My mom loved gardens.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts wʌt ˈɛvriˌwʌn sɛz maɪ mɑm lʌvd ˈɡɑrdənz/
dialogue.zh: 大家都這樣說。我媽媽很愛花園。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So what do you do, besides rescuing cats?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wʌt du ju du bɪˈsaɪdz rɪˈskjuɪŋ kæts/
dialogue.zh: 那妳除了救貓以外做什麼工作？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Vet tech, downtown. You?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæ vɛt tɛk ˌdaʊnˈtun ju/
dialogue.zh: 哈！我在市區當獸醫助理。你呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seventh grade science. Chaotic, but fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvənθ ɡreɪd ˈsaɪəns keɪˈɑtɪk bʌt fʌn/
dialogue.zh: 我是七年級自然老師。混亂，但好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, seventh graders? You seem way too calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ˈsɛvənθ ˌɡreɪdərz ju sim weɪ tu kɑm/
dialogue.zh: 等等，七年級？你看起來冷靜得過頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fake calm. Inside I'm screaming about lab safety.
dialogue.phonetic: /feɪk kɑm ɪnˈsaɪd aɪm ˈskrimɪŋ əˈbaʊt læb ˈseɪfti/
dialogue.zh: 裝的啦。我內心一直在為實驗室安全尖叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they actually listen to you at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðeɪ ˈæktʃuəli ˈlɪsən tə ju ət ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 那些學生真的會聽你說話嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half do. The other half are Julia's problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf du ði ˈʌðɚ hæf ɑr ˈdʒuljɚz ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 一半會聽。另一半就交給茱莉亞操心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ooh, careful. She's hosting. She can hear you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʊ ˈkɛrfʊl ʃiz ˈhoʊstɪn ʃi kæn hɪr ju/
dialogue.zh: 噓，小心。她是主人，會聽見你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good thing she's busy by the cake table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd θɪŋ ʃiz ˈbɪzi baɪ ðə keɪk ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 幸好她在蛋糕桌那邊忙著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cake? Which one? I've searched all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /keɪk wɪtʃ wʌn aɪv sɜrtʃt ɔl naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 蛋糕？哪一塊？我找了一整晚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lemon thing near the window. Follow me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɛmən θɪŋ nɪr ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ ˈfɑloʊ mi/
dialogue.zh: 窗邊那塊檸檬蛋糕。跟我來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lead the way, science teacher.
dialogue.phonetic: /lid ðə weɪ ˈsaɪəns ˈtitʃɚ/
dialogue.zh: 請帶路吧，老師大人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no. Did that just happen? The dip cup!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ dɪd ðæt dʒʌst hæpən ðə dɪp kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 噢不。剛剛是我撞倒的嗎？那杯蘸醬！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You hit the good rug. Berry dip. On white.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju hɪt ðə ɡʊd rʌɡ ˈbɛri dɪp ɑn waɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你撞到漂亮地毯了。莓果蘸醬。還是白色的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My host's mom made that rug. I'm so dead.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hoʊsts mɑm meɪd ðæt rʌɡ aɪm soʊ dɛd/
dialogue.zh: 那是主人媽媽親手織的。我完蛋了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, breathe. Club soda lifts berry stains.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ bris klʌb ˈsoʊdə lɪfts ˈbɛri steɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 先深呼吸。蘇打氣水能提起莓果漬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're a miracle worker. Where's club soda?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊrz ə ˈmɪrəkəl ˈwɜrkɚ wɛrz klʌb ˈsoʊdə/
dialogue.zh: 你是救星。蘇打氣水在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kitchen, far left. I'll grab napkins. Stay.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɪtʃən fɑr lɛft aɪl ɡræb ˈnæpkɪnz steɪ/
dialogue.zh: 廚房最左手邊。我去拿紙巾，你別動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Iris, come back! I don't know any kitchens!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaɪrɪs kʌm bæk aɪ dont noʊ ˈɛni ˈkɪtʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 艾莉絲妳回來！我連廚房都找不到！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Relax, I'm kidding. It's under the sink, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /riˈlæks aɪm ˈkɪdɪŋ ɪts ˈʌndɚ ðə sɪŋk raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 跟你開玩笑的。在水槽下面，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're a lifesaver. Here, hold the bottle.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊrz ə ˈlaɪfˌseɪvɚ hɪr hoʊld ðə ˈbɑtəl/
dialogue.zh: 你真是恩人。來，幫我扶住瓶子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pat, don't rub. I learned this from cats.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæt doʊnt rʌb aɪ lɜrnd ðɪs fɚm kæts/
dialogue.zh: 要按壓，不能搓。這是我跟貓學的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From cats? Okay, doctor of animals.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚm kæts oʊˈkeɪ ˈdɑktɚ ʌv ˈænəmələz/
dialogue.zh: 跟貓學的？好，貓博士。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Vet tech. Yes. Keep patting. Good patient.
dialogue.phonetic: /vɛt tɛk jɛs kip ˈpætɪŋ ɡʊd ˈpeɪʃənt/
dialogue.zh: 是獸醫助理。沒錯，繼續輕按。你很乖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look! It's actually fading. Total magic.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ɪts ˈæktʃuəli ˈfeɪdɪŋ ˈtoʊtəl ˈmædʒɪk/
dialogue.zh: 你看！痕跡真的在變淡。完全魔法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Told you. Cats teach you everything, eventually.
dialogue.phonetic: /toʊd ju kæts titʃ ju ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ ɪˈvɛnʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 我說過吧。遲早貓會教你所有事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Freeze. Julia's walking over here. Abort mission.
dialogue.phonetic: /friz ˈdʒuljəz ˈwɔkɪŋ ˈoʊvɚ hɪr əˈbɔrt ˈmɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 別動。茱莉亞走過來了。任務中止。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smile. It was me. I spilled the dip.
dialogue.phonetic: /smaɪl ɪts wʌz mi aɪ ˈspɪld ðə dɪp/
dialogue.zh: 笑一個，就說是我潑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What? No way. I can take the fall!
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt noʊ weɪ aɪ kæn teɪk ðə fɔl/
dialogue.zh: 什麼？不行。我可以自己扛！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Relax. She's laughing. She saw the whole thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /riˈlæks ʃiz ˈlæfɪŋ ʃi sɔ ði hoʊl θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 放輕鬆，她在笑。她全都看見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, thank goodness. You're brave, Iris.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ θæŋk ˈɡʊdnəs jʊrz breɪv ˈaɪrɪs/
dialogue.zh: 天哪，感謝。你好勇敢，艾莉絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fake brave. Like your calm teacher thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /feɪk breɪv laɪk jʊr kɑm ˈtitʃɚ θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 假勇敢啦。跟你那套冷靜老師模樣一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She waved at us. We're officially guests now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi weɪvd æt ʌs wɪrz əˈfɪʃəli ɡɛsts naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 她跟我們揮手了。我們正式變賓客了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, friends now? Where do you hide at parties?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ frɛndz naʊ wɛr du ju haɪd æt ˈpɑrtiz/
dialogue.zh: 所以我們是朋友了？聚會上你都躲哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snack table, always. It's the safe zone.
dialogue.phonetic: /snæk ˈteɪbəl ˈɔlˌweɪz ɪts ðə seɪf zon/
dialogue.zh: 點心桌，永遠都是。那裡最安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Elm Street, above the bakery. You?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛm strit əˈbʌv ðə ˈbeɪkəri ju/
dialogue.zh: 我住榆樹街，麵包店樓上。你呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cedar and Ninth! Iris, I walk right past you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsidɚ ænd naɪnθ ˈaɪrɪs aɪ wɔk raɪt pæst ju/
dialogue.zh: 我在雪松街九號口！艾莉絲，我常經過妳家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The blue door with the cat window?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə blu dɔr wɪð ðə kæˈt ˈwɪnˌdoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那扇藍色門、有貓窗的那家？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's yours?! My students doodle on that window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts jɔrz maɪ ˈstjuˈdɛnts ˈduːdəl ɑn ðæt ˈwɪnˌdoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那是妳家？！我學生老在那扇窗上亂畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, which room is your class, exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt wɪtʃ rum ɪz jʊr klæs ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 等等，你的班級確切在哪間教室？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Room twelve. See? Small, weird town.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum twɛlv siː smɔl wɪrd taʊn/
dialogue.zh: 十二號教室。看吧，小鎮就是又小又怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small world. Same snack table, too, apparently.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl wɜrld seɪm snæk ˈteɪbəl tu əˈpɛrəntli/
dialogue.zh: 世界真小。連點心桌都共用，顯然。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New rule: Thursdays, lemon cake, saved for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu rul ˈθɜrzˌdeɪz ˈlɛmən keɪk seɪvd fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 新規矩：每週四，檸檬蛋糕留給妳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. I'll bring cat stories. You bring papers?
dialogue.phonetic: /dil aɪl brɪŋ kæˈt ˈstɔriz ju brɪŋ ˈpeɪpərz/
dialogue.zh: 成交。我帶貓咪故事，你帶改作業？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grading and gossip. Perfect trade, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡreɪdɪŋ ænd ˈɡɑsɪp ˈpɜrfɪkt treɪd ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 改作業加閒聊。這交易太完美了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheers, Theo. Best party since I moved here.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɪrz ˈθi.oʊ bɛst ˈpɑrti sɪns aɪ muvd hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 舉杯，西奧。這是我搬來之後最開心的一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cheers, Iris. Next time, bring the cats!
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɪrz ˈaɪrɪs nɛkst taɪm brɪŋ ðə kæts/
dialogue.zh: 舉杯，艾莉絲。下次把貓也帶來！

script.youtube_description:
第一次走進聚會，全場一個人也不認識，英文怎麼辦？
這一集是60句完整的自我介紹對話：交換姓名、聊工作、怎麼破冰、發生小悲劇怎麼救場，全部一聽就會。

你會學到：
・ how to introduce yourself naturally（自然自我介紹）
・ work small talk and name tricks（工作閒聊與記名字的技巧）
・ polite humor and quick repairs（有禮幽默與秒救場）

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，不用背，多聽就會用。

訂閱我們，下一場聚會你不會再站在飲料桌旁發呆！
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en:
You walk into a party. You know exactly zero people. What now?
This episode is one full 60-line conversation: introducing names, talking about work, a dip disaster, and a new friend by the end.

You will hear:
・ natural self-introductions
・ work small talk that keeps going
・ how to recover from a small spill with humor

The second half is line-by-line listening and repeat-after-me practice. No memorizing - just listen, and it sticks.

Subscribe for more everyday English that turns strangers into friends!
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
聚會裡一個朋友也沒有，怎麼開口認識新面孔？
自我介紹時，工作要怎麼聊才不尷尬？

script.thumbnail_action: holding a napkin near the snack table
